title: [Bug] Fireworks API Fails to Connect
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker, Other

### 📌 Version

1.49.12 <local db - postgres version>

### 💻 Operating System

Windows, Ubuntu

### 🌐 Browser

Chrome, Edge, Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

The Fireworks.ai api does not work at all. Regardless of what API key is entered, the connection will fail. It appears the endpoint may be incorrect.

Have verified this on several machines on two different networks. Have verified no traffic is denied by firewall.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d05fedaf-9cdc-4a6a-a986-19f30b104848)

### 📷 Recurrence Steps

Install and configure Lobe Chat Database Version.
Attempt to enter a Fireworks.ai api key and click the connection test button.

### 🚦 Expected Behavior

Entering the api key and clicking connect should allow use of the fireworks.ai provider.

### 📝 Additional Information

Have also attempted this on a regular base lobe-chat docker installation without the database with the same result.

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
The issue involves a failure to connect to the Fireworks.ai API, which is an LLM provider. This aligns with the "Model access misconfiguration" sub-category under LLM operation issues, as it mentions problems with API key usage and endpoint configuration.
